artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan formalizing the **Files to modify** per-phase convention, building a shared harvester, wiring it into all four plan-postflight call sites, and backfilling file_scope cross-repo.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system codebase, a helper invoked as `update-task-status.sh postflight <N> <phase> <sid>` is called from FOUR independent locations for the plan phase, not one: orchestrator-postflight.sh Stage 7, reconcile-task-status.sh (two sites), and skill-reviser/SKILL.md Stage 7 (the /revise path). Any change that must apply 'at plan postflight' has to enumerate all four, or /revise and the reconciliation self-heal path silently diverge. The general planning rule: before wiring behavior into a lifecycle postflight, grep for every call site of the status helper rather than trusting a dispatch's singular phrasing. A companion pattern: before adding a new state.json write path, check whether update-task-status.sh already exposes a flag with the needed semantics (e.g. --file-scope-add's additive union merge riding inside the existing mutex-guarded state-write.sh invocation) -- widening an existing flag's target_status restriction is consistently lower-risk than adding a second writer.
